entries.title: Prompt Cache Diagnostics is now generally available in the Responses API for GPT-5.6 and later supported models.
entries.summary: 提示缓存诊断功能正式上线，可分析缓存未命中原因。

entries.title: Released GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst and GPT Image 2.5 Flare for image generation and editing through the Image API and the Responses API image generation tool.
entries.summary: 发布两款GPT Image 2.5模型，分别侧重编辑精度与生成速度。

entries.title: Released GPT-6 Astra, our most capable model, built for the hardest end-to-end work.
entries.summary: 发布GPT-6 Astra，面向复杂端到端推理、编程及研究任务。

entries.title: Added new controls for long-running work with GPT-6 Astra in the Responses API:
entries.summary: Responses API新增异步工具调用、中途引导及推理强度调整。

entries.title: Updated API errors so applications can distinguish traffic that increases too quickly from temporary model overload.
entries.summary: 更新API错误码，以区分流量增长过快与临时模型过载。

entries.title: Connections to `api.openai.com` can now use IPv6.
Mutual TLS (mTLS) and X.509 workload identity federation are now generally available for the OpenAI API.
entries.summary: OpenAI API正式支持mTLS与X.509工作负载身份联合。

entries.title: Announced the deprecation of `whisper-1`, `gpt-4o-transcribe`, `gpt-4o-mini-transcribe`, and `gpt-4o-transcribe-diarize`.
entries.summary: 多款旧转录模型将于2027年2月26日停用，Assistants API已关闭。

entries.title: API customers can now select regional processing for an individual request by using a prefixed domain with an API key from a project having Global geography.
entries.summary: API客户现可按单次请求选择区域处理位置。

entries.title: GPT-5.6 Sol now costs $4 per million input tokens and $20 per million output tokens, representing 20% lower input pricing and 33% lower output pricing.
entries.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol输入与输出价格分别下调20%和33%。

entries.title: Released the Prompt Caching dashboard on the OpenAI API platform.
entries.summary: 上线提示缓存仪表板，可查看命中率及各类缓存令牌指标。

entries.title: Transparent backgrounds are now available in preview for `gpt-image-2` and `gpt-image-2-2026-04-21` in the Images API and the Responses API image generation tool.
entries.summary: GPT Image 2在图像及Responses API中预览支持透明背景。
